events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York, starting on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, which kicked off on this day in 1969. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the world mourned the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll through generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the profound legacy of rapper Tupac Shakur, whose life was tragically cut short after a shooting in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a lyrical legend whose voice and impact are still felt decades after his passing.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the music world lost an unparalleled guitar virtuoso, Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we said goodbye to a true guitar legend. Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks and that legendary zebra crossing cover, on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, born on this day in 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking with The Pretenders!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The inimitable Liam Gallagher, former Oasis frontman, celebrates his 54th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock and roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine released
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' first graced our airwaves. A song that still resonates globally.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod. Remember carrying your entire music library in your pocket for the first time?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and his incredible cinematic legacy.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday, born in 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese. From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles release The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. An eclectic masterpiece with something for everyone.

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since the world lost Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles release Rubber Soul
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' hit the shelves. A pivotal album that marked a new direction for the Fab Four.
